paper text.text:
The nonplanar, $K_5$-minor-free graph $H$ contains a $K_{3,3}$
subdivision. If $bd$ is present, $G-bd$ is toroidal, so
$H-bd$ is planar by Corollary~\ref{r1:five-criterion} and the
subdivision must use $bd$.
Apply Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision} with the five
attachments and added edges $ab,ac,ad,ae$, also including $bd$
when present. Its reduction keeps the interior connected,
all five attachments, and the completion nonplanar.
By Corollary~\ref{r1:five-criterion}, minimality therefore leaves
$B$ unchanged, so Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction}
lists every possibility.
Of its $217{,}376$ candidates, all except
$\mathfrak T_{20},\mathfrak T_{23}$ have a $K_5$ minor, a proper
nontoroidal minor, or two twin triples meeting in zero or two
vertices~\supp{E22}. Both remaining graphs

vertex names: Psi_3: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with neighbourhood {a,d,e}, as in Section 6. Further vertices with neighbourhood {a,b,c} are p3, p4, and with {a,d,e} r3, r4. Interior vertices of bridges are u0, u1, ...

disjoint twin triples.meaning: Section 6 assumes any two twin triples share exactly one vertex
